scope: same-controller re-pair followed by guarded five-minute Zone 1 counter recovery

guarded_counter_and_duration_discriminat.conclusion: The valve retained command sequence 3 across the same-identity repair. The rejected five-minute trials were caused by the unvalidated multi-byte duration payload, not by the command counter.

sequential_counter_confirmation.result: Counter 4 authenticated, independent telemetry confirmed Zone 1 watering, the valve stopped itself, and the gateway retained counter 5.

findings: The five-minute trial did not reach duration acceptance because no authenticated command response or independent watering report was observed.
Before the same-controller re-pair, authenticated responses to command sequences 1 and 2 established 3 as the next command sequence.
The custom gateway unconditionally reset its stored counter to 1 after the same controller, companion, valve, and selector were re-paired.
Both guarded sequence-1 attempts and the final guarded sequence-2 attempt timed out; no sequence beyond the two bounded recovery candidates was guessed.

The sequence-scoped d0/86/83/00 reply family is a valve-originated negative response: it uses the derived controller role as source and the valve endpoint as destination, unlike the outbound gateway command route.

Sequences 3, 4, and 5 all received that negative response for the additive-encoded five-minute payload. Sequence 3 immediately received an authenticated positive response when retried with the previously validated 60-second 9e00 duration payload.

The valve therefore retained sequence 3 across the same-identity repair; the gateway reset only its local copy. The five-minute failure independently disproves the additive multi-byte transmit encoding as a complete model.
Selector-0x07 link reports continued through the guard windows, proving the association remained alive but not independently proving valve state.
A same-association repair must preserve an already authenticated command counter unless wire evidence proves that the valve reset it. A genuinely new association may still initialize sequence 1.

A second sequential 60-second open authenticated at retained sequence 4, advanced to 5, and returned to idle 61.414214 seconds after the immediate response; this rejects an accidental one-off sequence-3 acceptance.
Durations whose two-second count already contains low-byte bit 7 require new stock-gateway evidence before local transmission; state decode evidence alone is insufficient to construct that command.
